content.title: About
content.content: Spanish rice with added fat is a pre‑cooked rice seasoned with classic Spanish spices (paprika, garlic, onion) and enriched with vegetable fat for a richer flavor and softer texture. It is ready to eat after a quick heat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Traditional Spanish rice is often cooked with olive oil; this version uses a neutral vegetable fat.
The product became popular in fast‑paced societies because of its convenience.
The rice is partially boiled before packaging, preserving some nutrients.
The combination of spices and fat gives a stronger taste than plain boiled rice.
It is frequently used in school cafeterias and corporate catering.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Rice provides quick‑release carbohydrates, and the added fat raises the calorie content, useful for higher energy needs.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Processing retains B1, B3 and B6 vitamins, which support metabolism.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Spices such as paprika and garlic may aid digestive function.

items.title: Improves nutrient absorption
items.content: Fat helps absorb fat‑soluble vitamins and enhances the overall aroma of the dish.

items.title: Convenient preparation
items.content: The product is ready after a short heat, saving time in the kitchen.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: Added fat increases energy density, so portion control is important, especially on weight‑managed diets.

items.title: Allergy to vegetable oils
items.content: Some individuals may be sensitive to certain plant‑based fats.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Salt may be used to enhance flavor; people with hypertension should monitor intake.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Some flavorings may contain gluten; check the label if you have celiac disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the product in the microwave or on a skillet, stir to distribute the fat evenly. Serve as a side dish with meat, fish, vegetables, or incorporate into casseroles and salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place with the package tightly sealed. After opening, keep refrigerated and use within 3–5 days.
